search_text: 微分方程组初值问题 $\begin{cases}x\prime+y\prime=1,\\x\prime-y\prime=1+\delta(t-1),\\x(0)=a,\ y(0)=b\end{cases}$ 的解为（ ）。 $\begin{cases}x(t)=t+a+\dfrac12u(t-1),\\y(t)=b-\dfrac12u(t-1)\end{cases}$ $\begin{cases}x(t)=a+\dfrac12u(t-1),\\y(t)=b-\dfrac12u(t-1)\end{cases}$ $\begin{cases}x(t)=t+a+\dfrac12u(t-1),\\y(t)=t+b-\dfrac12u(t-1)\end{cases}$ $\begin{cases}x(t)=t+a+\dfrac12u(t-1),\\y(t)=t+b+\dfrac12u(t-1)\end{cases}$ $X(s)=\dfrac1{s^2}+\dfrac{e^{-s}}{2s}+\dfrac as$，$Y(s)=\dfrac bs-\dfrac{e^{-s}}{2s}$，反变换即得选项 1。
